name: American Legion Auxiliary Michigan Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Michigan
what_you_do: Spend a week running a mock state government and court system with students from across Michigan. You learn how state government works. You also practice leadership.
who_can_apply: Female high school students who will finish their junior year in spring 2027. You must have at least one more semester before graduation.
pay_detail: $25 registration fee, paid after you are assigned a sponsor. The sponsor pays the $450 fee to attend.
deadline_text: Apply by Apr 30, 2027. The 86th session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at Michigan State University.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online delegate application. It goes to a sponsor in your area. The link is on the Michigan Girls State page and the 2027 flyer. Questions go to the Girls State chairman, Beryl Robbins, at berylrobbins1980@gmail.com or (313) 318-6845.
notes: Not a job. The page also lists a Samsung scholarship and a government manual to read before attending.
